panels.description: TJ reaches the boathouse, wet and crooked, while the granddaughter steadies him. Leave upper wall space.
TJ drops the broken drone component at older Alex's feet. Keep the component and wet dock dominant; leave upper space for the impact sound.
Older Alex and his granddaughter look down at the broken component between them. Keep their hands and the object clear.
The component lies between the granddaughter, Alex and TJ on the dock, forming a quiet triangle. Leave surrounding boards uncluttered.
